svg.title: 2. Spike and cost guardrails
svg.text: If something gets through anyway: find out the same day, not on the invoice
Six places to put a ceiling: absorb a real spike, stop a runaway bill
Example spike: a TV feature sends 80,000 sessions in 3 hours. Peak about 740 API requests/s, about 90 Lambda functions running at once, 35 sign-ups/s for two minutes.
sign-up and sign-in go straight to the user pool
Most bytes never reach the Region
on request rate catch a runaway
Budget alerts do not stop spending. The throttles above are what actually cap it.
